budget_items.what_was_recorded: The school committee sent a revised figure for the supplemental school appropriation, which the Board then put into the amended Article H.
budget_items.quote: they did receive a revised number from the school committee in the amount of $948,136.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Members and officials gave differing override percentages, with and without ARPA and ESSER funding.
budget_items.quote: what they appropriating is not a full 5.44% increase and their starting number next year will only reflect the 4.44% because the arpa funds will not be included.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Last year's overlay transfer covered abatements without an override.
budget_items.quote: the town was able to pay out over $1m in abatements without an override.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $6,648.42 request to raise a 19.5 hour employee to 24 benefitted hours was reported removed from the budget.
budget_items.quote: request from the council on aging for $6,648.42 to make a 19.5 hour employee to a benefitted

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reported the final gap closed at approximately this amount.
Positions deferred pending the contract impact were put at $195,000, or $150,000 with health insurance.
budget_items.quote: chair jeffreys asked for confirmation that those positions total $195,000 and town manager lemieux stated they would be $150,000 with health insurance.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The salary reserve was raised from a stated level because of the SAP impact and expected DPW union negotiations.
budget_items.quote: the salary reserve line was at $100,000 but based on the sap impact the wage was at around $111,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Recent conversations with the vendor indicated a price increase of up to the stated percentage, so the contract is going out to bid.
budget_items.quote: there is up to a 70% increase to extend the bid so they are going to put that contract out to bid
